Recognise 1971 genocide: Ghatak Dalal Nirmul Committee urges EU
2021-12-09T22:32:41+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/recognise-1971-genocide-ghatak-dalal-nirmul-committee-urges-eu-2913761

Ekattorer Ghatak Dalal Nirmul Committee has urged the European Union (EU) to recognise the genocide inflicted on Bangladesh by the Pakistani Army during the 1971 War of Liberation.

A memorandum in this regard sent to the EU president today also urged to condemn the ongoing genocide across the world and take necessary steps to ensure the safe return of Rohingyas to their homeland where they experienced crackdown by Myanmar military.

The committee made the call from a virtual conference organised on the occasion of "International Day of Commemoration and Dignity of the Victims of the Crime of Genocide and of the Prevention of this Crime".

The United Nation established the day in 2015 to raise awareness of the genocide convention.

"We, victims, and survivors of genocides from different countries, along with politicians, academicians, jurists, artistes, anti-genocide campaigners, human rights, and peace activists urge EU for the recognition of Bangladesh genocide of 1971, the condemnation of all genocidal crimes currently happening across the world and the creation of an effective pressure by the EU on the Government of Myanmar to ensure the safe return of Rohingya Refugees from Bangladesh", the memorandum read.

The international conference was presided over by the Nirmul Committee President Shariar Kabir while Information and Broadcasting Minister Dr Hasan Mahmud addressed the programme as chief guest.

Genocide sufferers, genocide researchers, lawmakers, human rights, and peace activists from 14 countries took part in the international conference.
